photoProfile.coordinates: Zero-based source pixels; right and bottom exclusive.
photoProfile.rows: Mean of nine unannotated center rows, rounded to nearest uint8 RGB.
photoProfile.sampling: Lanczos horizontal resample from 10574 native source columns to 4096; repeat the one radial row 16 times.
photoProfile.orientation: Left to right, radially outward: C, B, Cassini division, A, F.
photoProfile.blackBorders: Crop retains tiny dark fade margins; center nonblack C starts near x1110, F ends near x11642.
photoProfile.uncertainty: The mosaic bands curve with image row. Nine nearby rows limit lateral blur. Landmarks and normalization are visual registrations; the approximate published 7 km/pixel is not treated as exact radius calibration.

radialMapping.application: Normalized photographic radial reference mapped onto each saved fictional ring. No Saturn radius or physical map resolution is changed.

authoredOpacity.fineStructure: Within each visually registered zone, linearly map clipped P5/P95-normalized actual photo linear Rec.709 luminance to its published broad tau range. Cassini division uses authored tau .002-.075. No periodic function, noise or repeated synthetic stripe is added.
authoredOpacity.darkGapMask: Multiply tau by clamp((photo sRGB Rec.709 luminance - .012)/(.07-.012),0,1)^2 to preserve actual dark scan gaps.
authoredOpacity.scope: C/B/A appearance and photographed gaps; outside A remains tenuous. F/G/E ring opacity is not synthesized.

provenance.transform: Decode pinned original PIA11142 JPEG; average crop center rows in original encoded RGB, Lanczos resample horizontally, repeat the radial RGB scan to 4096x16, add explicitly authored photo-modulated alpha, encode lossless RGBA PNG. No recoloring, generated fine detail, model GLB or model ring RGB is used.
